label: echoed z early in the copy phase (sparse, near-threshold)
explanation: Fires only in the copy phase, almost always (94% of activations and mass) when the fed-back input is z (a few on n), at early recall positions (recall_idx 1-3, t=9-12) of long sequences (L>=7), i.e. when many outputs remain. Never fires in the original or delimiter phase, or on first occurrences of a token. Activations are weak (mean 0.13) and sparse: only about 2% of copy-phase z inputs at recall_idx<=4 activate, so precision is very low. Strongest examples have z inputs right after <DEL> or at position 1 of z-initial sequences, especially repeated z (zz...), and out_tok z/t/j/k/m/1 raises the firing rate, but no simple condition reaches precision above ~0.2. The feature is best read as a z-in-copy detector whose threshold crossing depends on diffuse context.

scorecard.summary: Weighted combination of 40 cues. Raise it: phase=2 & in_tok=n (+4.83), phase=2 & in_tok=z (+4.18), in_tok=z (+3.22), phase=2 & out_tok=z (+3.20), prev_tok=e (+2.80), phase=2 & out_tok=t (+2.58). Lower it: next_out=- (-3.53), to_go=1 (-3.05), to_go=2 (-2.11), orig5=- (-1.89).
